partners.middleDesc: Owning and operating unique, world-class resort havens such as Six Senses Ninh Van Bay or Ana Mandara Da Lat, Tasco deeply understands the art of honoring privacy and absolute personalized luxury. Viet Tri Legacy Lakeside is the perfect continuation of that philosophy, bringing a completely new standard of living — where luxury does not need to be ostentatious but is deeply felt through every tranquil moment.

slides.desc: In the heart of the sacred ancestral land, where proud rivers converge, a masterpiece is quietly taking shape.
No noise. No ostentation. Viet Tri Legacy Lakeside is a private haven for distinguished individuals — a tranquil retreat to savor the true value of living after journeys of conquering new heights.
Beside the gentle lake, a thousand-year royal aura crystallizes in stillness and refined, enduring values. Here, time does not pass — it lingers and becomes a legacy for generations.

map.narrative: Located at the heart of the city, Viet Tri Legacy Lakeside enjoys a priceless dual pace of life. Seamlessly connecting to key medical, commercial, and cultural destinations in moments, yet returning to a private, serene haven.

values.intro: In the heart of the sacred ancestral land, where proud rivers converge, a masterpiece is quietly taking shape.

items.title: A secluded address at the center of connection
items.desc: Absolute seclusion and privacy right in the administrative and commercial core of Viet Tri — the vibrant city life lies just outside, yet once the gate closes, complete serenity awaits.

items.title: Where waters gather, prosperity endures
items.desc: A riverside, lakeside location brings a serene and expansive living space, embracing the flow of royal energy and lasting prosperity for its owners.

items.title: A collection of 92 one-of-a-kind legacies
items.desc: A limited number creates exclusive value. Each mansion is a precious asset, guaranteeing sustainable value appreciation potential.

items.title: A resort experience at your doorstep
items.desc: Exclusive amenities including a Clubhouse, swimming pool, sports courts and a water park turn every ordinary day into a relaxing getaway for all the senses.

items.title: Architectural signatures from international firms
items.desc: The convergence of global design brands (WATG, LJ Group, NOOR) delivers perfect harmony between planning, architecture, landscape and interiors.

items.title: Credibility guaranteed by developer Tasco
items.desc: Tasco's extensive experience in creating unique resorts is a commitment to construction quality, a service ecosystem and long-term added value.

items.title: Exemplary operation and security services
items.desc: The partnership with Ana Services ensures a closed security system, meticulously maintained landscapes and a premium quality of life for years to come.

items.title: A community of elite residents
items.desc: A gathering place for distinguished individuals sharing the same status, aesthetic taste and living standards, creating a civilized living environment and a foundation for lasting connections.

in tranquil seclusion

items.title: Cafe Lounge
items.desc: Indulge in gentle, delicate flavors within an artistic ambiance.

items.title: Library & Art Space
items.desc: A tranquil reading nook accentuated by fine artworks and lush gardens.

items.title: Wellness & Fitness
items.desc: Nurture wellness with a modern Gym, mindful Yoga, relaxing Sauna and prestigious 3D Golf area.

family.title:

items.title: Childhood Haven
items.desc: A safe, enclosed children's playground empowering youthful memories amidst nature.

items.title: Elite Gathering
items.desc: Outdoor socializing spaces and shaded stands where like-minded neighbors share refined pleasures.

items.title: Tranquil Corner
items.desc: A private meditative retreat where homeowners find balance and harmony with ancestral vitality.

comparison.comparisonAria: Compare Modern Indochine and Contemporary Tropical designs

tropical.title:
Contemporary Tropical - 
Lakeside Tropical Breath
tropical.desc: Honoring freedom and openness, Contemporary Tropical style maximizes natural sunlight and air circulation. The open design, wooden louvers and large glass walls dissolve the boundary between indoors and outdoors, bringing nature into every rhythm of life.

indochine.title:
Modern Indochine - 
Timeless Aristocratic Heritage
indochine.desc: Celebrating sophistication and prestige, Modern Indochine seamlessly combines French classical grandeur with traditional East Asian soul. Elegant graceful arches, warm natural timber, and intricate artisanal carvings form a bespoke living sanctuary that endures through generations.
